status: frozen 2026-11-07 before scoring any pair beyond the sensitivity sample
question: What is the CooperBench paper's coop-solo gap made of, for each of its five models, once coop and solo are scored in one harness: evaluation artifacts, conflicts a resolver can fix, and the failures that remain, split into division of labor and integration?
models_note: names are the keys of the published result files; GPT-5 and Claude run first, then the other three
pairs: every usable pair with both a published coop run and a published solo run

per_pair.merge: the two agents' published patches merged and tested with the released harness (calibration.json)
per_pair.conflicts: when our merge conflicts: git's union merge (merge_union.json) and the frozen gpt-6-luna re-merge (merge.json), each tested on both features
per_pair.solo: the published solo patch tested on both features
per_pair.own: each agent's own patch tested alone, for pairs that still fail after the llm re-merge

levels: L1 our merge without conflict resolution, L2 union, L3 llm, as in configs/paper_sensitivity.json; a merge that our harness reports as identical counts as clean, a pair with missing input is left out and counted

decomposition.paper_gap: G0 = solo recorded minus coop recorded, summed over pairs
decomposition.artifact: A = G0 minus (our solo minus our coop at L1): the part of the gap that correct evaluation alone removes; negative when it widens the gap
decomposition.resolvable: R = our coop at L3 minus our coop at L1 (union part: L2 minus L1): pairs a conflict resolver rescues
decomposition.remaining: G3 = our solo minus our coop at L3 = G0 - A - R; the positive part (solo passes, coop fails at L3) is split by the failed features of the L3 result: integration when the feature's own patch passes alone, division of labor when it fails; the negative part counts pairs where coop passes and solo fails

decision_rule: Descriptive, per model: each component's share of G0 with a 95% bootstrap interval clustered by task; a component is called a driver of the gap only when its interval excludes zero. Primary question: among pairs where solo passes and coop still fails at L3, is division of labor at least half? At least half for a model: the main remaining cause for that model is agents failing their own feature when paired. Integration at least half: the main remaining cause is code that does not fit together. Neither: reported as mixed. The census on our merges (post hoc) found division of labor ahead of integration for GPT-5 and Claude; this tests that on all pairs and on three more models.
results: decomposition_rows.csv and decomposition_summary.json in the output directory
